title: Manufacturer fact file
description: One file per maker at data/manufacturers/<slug>.json. Every fact is a field object with value, source_url and checked. A fact the maker does not publish is stored as the exact string "nicht angegeben" and never guessed. scripts/check-data.mjs enforces this schema without dependencies.

name.description: Brand name as the maker writes it.

legal_entity.description: Legal entity that sells to DACH buyers, with seat.

country_of_origin.description: Country where the maker is based and produces.

founded.description: Founding year as the maker publishes it.

production_locations.description: Own factories by town and country.

dach_office.description: Office or showroom presence relevant to DACH buyers.

dach_service.description: How service and repairs reach DACH buyers.

max_stack_weight.description: Highest published weight stack on a selectorised machine.

customisation.description: Published colour, upholstery and logo options, and whether they cost extra.

lead_time.description: Published time from order to delivery or handover.

financing_leasing.description: Financing or leasing the maker offers itself or through partners.

price_publication.description: Whether and how prices are published.

stark_bei.description: Editorial: real strengths, each backed by the cited sources.

weniger_geeignet_wenn.description: Editorial: buyer situations the maker fits less well, each backed by the cited sources.

best_fit_buyer.description: Editorial fit label ("Beste Wahl für ..."); no scores.

value.description: The fact, or the exact string "nicht angegeben" when the maker does not publish it.

source_url.description: Live public page(s) that state the value. Required unless value is "nicht angegeben".

checked.description: ISO date on which the value was confirmed on the source page.

note.description: Optional internal remark, for example a conflict between sources. Not for publication.
